description: Check the exact package versions in one lockfile against OSV.dev and report known CVEs as CVE001 with severity and fixed versions. Accepts package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, composer.lock, requirements.txt (exact == pins) or go.sum. Sends ecosystem, package name and version to api.osv.dev, never the lockfile or source. Skips npm packages not resolved from the public registry and requirements files with a custom index. Not covered: container images, OS packages, Cargo, Gemfile. A failed lookup is an error, never a clean result.

maxFindings.description: Maximum findings returned; totals include all matching findings

name: scan_dependencies
title: Scan dependencies for known CVEs
